summary: Creates explicit point lists with optional P and custom attributes, with one point primitive per point unless disabled. It is useful for single-point constants, specification POPs, fields, forces, and attribute-only POP data.

key_params.name: createpointprim
key_params.note: Create one point primitive for every point

key_params.name: attr0numcomps
key_params.note: Number of components in the new attribute

key_params.name: parmcolorspace
key_params.note: Interpret color parameters in a selected color space when a working color space is active

key_params.name: parmreferencewhite
key_params.note: Reference-white treatment for converting parameter colors into the working color space

common_gotchas: Point POP can create data with no P attribute; that is valid for constants or specification data but not for spatial operators.
Single-point POPs behave like uniforms in Math Mix and Math Combine when combined with multi-point POPs.
Disable Create Point Primitives when a pure point list without primitive records is required.
